Arioli–Benzi, DOI:10.1093/imanum/drx029, §§4–5, derives the general consistent finite element mass matrix and studies condition numbers; it does not derive exact L∞ norms.

value.rationale: Uniformly classifies a natural infinite family of genuinely branched one-dimensional finite-element spaces, identifies sharp extremizers and the precise surprising s=2,k=9 instability boundary, and finds the global sharp but unattained 458/225 ceiling. The entire-clique-size dichotomy cannot be read off from vertex degrees or standard interval bounds and is an intrinsic robustness fact for network approximation.
